# REL-37: Analytics: volume, success rate, latency and failure reasons by processor

## Outcome

Analytics: volume, success rate, latency and failure reasons by processor

## Acceptance

- [x] Numbers derived from payment_events
- [x] Filterable by time range and processor
- [x] Shows simulated revenue recovered and success-rate uplift against the static-routing baseline
- [x] Baseline figures come from the REL-30 results files
- [x] Analytics endpoints require the API key and the UI reads them through server routes; revenue recovered is split by rescue path and time to explanation by source with fallback reasons, reusing `api/app/reporting/` rather than a second implementation (PR-20, PR-31)
- [x] Event-derived figures come from `payment_events`; amounts, currency and the handling processor are joined from `payments` (events carry no money, and terminal events have no processor; REL-32 exit review, R1), so no event schema change is needed
- [x] The api reads the REL-30 baseline from `docs/evaluation/outage-demo/results.json` mounted read-only by compose (path from a setting); when the file is absent the analytics answer says the baseline is unavailable instead of failing
